retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Bachelor programmes and most master programmes at state institutions generally have no tuition. Continuing education master programmes and private institutions may charge tuition.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU citizens 1,500 euros per semester for bachelor, master, Diplom and state examination programmes. Doctoral students are exempt from this charge.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Bavarian institutions may charge tuition to students from outside the EU or EEA. The amount depends on the institution and degree.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: All students pay a semester contribution of between 70 and 430 euros, separate from tuition, at enrolment and before each semester. A transport ticket may be included.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Visas, student and prospective student routes
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: DAAD distinguishes the student visa for applicants already accepted by an institution from the prospective student visa for applicants awaiting admission or an entrance examination. Check the applicable route with the German mission before applying.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Students from outside the EU or EEA must present proof of financial resources already when they apply for a study visa. Check the exact amount and accepted forms of proof with the German mission or DAAD before applying.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: International students do not have unlimited permission to work in Germany. Check the current rules before planning to earn money during study.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting.
retained_line_reviews.question: What tuition conditions apply in Germany?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Every student pays a semester contribution of between 70 and 430 euros at enrolment and before each semester. This is separate from tuition. A transport ticket may be included.
retained_line_reviews.question: What is the semester contribution in Germany?

retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Yes. Students from outside the EU or EEA must present proof of financial resources when they apply for a study visa.
retained_line_reviews.question: Do students from India need to show money for a German study visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: DAAD: Costs of education and living in Germany
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Only within limits. International students do not have unlimited permission to work, so the current rules should be checked first.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Indian students who want to study in Italy first apply for admission to the Italian institution, then complete pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, then apply for a study visa by appointment at a VFS centre. Each institution sets its own admission requirements, deadlines and tuition fees.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Italian Consulate Bengaluru: institution-specific admission requirements and fees
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The Bengaluru consulate states that each institution has its own tuition fees. Confirm the selected institution and programme fee; the visa procedure does not establish scholarship entitlement.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate lists three mandatory steps: apply for admission on the chosen institution website within its deadline, apply online for pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal within the deadlines, and once pre-enrolled apply for the visa.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: A D visa is needed if the course lasts more than 90 days, and a C visa if it lasts less than 90 days.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Visa applications are submitted only by prior appointment at a VFS centre. The consulate names Bangalore, Chennai and Hyderabad.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: All students must attend a mandatory video interview when they submit the visa application.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Under Italian law, processing of a D visa application can take up to 90 days from the day the consulate receives it. If the consulate asks for extra documents, the total time is likely to be longer.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate currently links a study visa checklist labelled 2025-2026 and recommends complete documentation. That linked edition is historical; confirm the checklist for the intended intake rather than applying an old deadline.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: If the Italian institution requires a Declaration of Value (DOV) and the previous studies were completed in an Indian state under the Bengaluru consulate, the consulate publishes a separate DOV checklist.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Yes. The consulate lists pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, within the deadlines, as a mandatory step after applying for admission and before applying for the visa.
retained_line_reviews.question: Do Indian students need Universitaly pre-enrolment to study in Italy?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: A D visa for courses lasting more than 90 days and a C visa for courses lasting less than 90 days.
retained_line_reviews.question: Which Italian study visa do Indian students need?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Yes. All students must attend a mandatory video interview when they submit the application at the VFS centre.
retained_line_reviews.question: Is there an interview for the Italian study visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru: Study in Italy
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The Consulate General of Italy in Bengaluru states that its official visa email is bangalore.visa@esteri.it, and it warns students to ignore messages from other addresses that claim to come from the consulate and never to share personal or financial information with them.
retained_line_reviews.question: How can students avoid fake emails about the Italian study visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Study in Europe (European Commission): Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Full-time study in Slovak at public institutions can involve no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry fees. Check the individual programme requirements and budget for living expenses separately. Admission decisions and deadlines are set by each institution.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Study in Europe (European Commission): Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The European Commission profile states that Slovak-language study may have no tuition and foreign-language programmes, including English, carry tuition. Confirm the selected programme fee; living expenses are separate.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Study in Europe (European Commission): Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The study portal estimates a total yearly budget of around 7,000 to 15,000 euros, including tuition and living costs.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Study in Europe (European Commission): Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic supports study, research and teaching stays and is open to international students, PhD candidates and researchers. Check the programme page for current eligibility and deadlines.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Slovak Republic in New Delhi: National visa
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Applications for a Slovak national visa are submitted at a diplomatic mission of the Slovak Republic. Indian applicants use the Embassy in New Delhi.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Slovak Embassy New Delhi: contact and consular appointments
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The embassy contact page says visa applications are accepted by prior appointment. Check the current study-specific booking procedure; an employment booking route is not a student booking route.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Slovak Embassy New Delhi: national visa, basic documents
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The embassy basic national-visa list includes an application form, a valid travel document, photograph, evidence of the purpose of residence and health insurance. Additional documents depend on the applicable category.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: European Commission: Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: For non-EU students, the European Commission profile lists proof of admission, financial means and health insurance among the usual application requirements. Contact the embassy for the detailed route-specific list.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: European Commission: Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Slovak-language study may have no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry tuition. Check the programme and budget separately for living costs.
retained_line_reviews.question: How does language affect tuition in Slovakia?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Slovak Republic in New Delhi: National visa
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: At the Embassy of the Slovak Republic in New Delhi. Check the embassy page for the current appointment method.
retained_line_reviews.question: Where do Indian students apply for a Slovak national visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Study in Europe (European Commission): Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Yes. The European Commission study portal says students apply directly to the chosen faculty or university.
retained_line_reviews.question: Do students apply directly to Slovak universities?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: European Commission: Slovakia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The European Commission profile lists health insurance among the usual visa or residence application requirements for non-EU students. The embassy gives the detailed requirements for the applicable route.
retained_line_reviews.question: What insurance evidence should a non-EU student check?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Most UK Student visa applicants need funding for the course fees shown on their CAS and living costs. Current monthly amounts are 1,171 pounds outside London or 1,529 pounds in London, for up to nine months. Some financial-evidence exemptions apply; check the rules for your circumstances.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Student visa eligibility
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The Student visa route is for applicants aged 16 or over with an offer from a licensed student sponsor, sufficient funding and the required English ability. Applicants aged 16 or 17 need parental consent.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Student visa knowledge of English
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Applicants usually need to prove their English ability. GOV.UK describes qualifying education and approved tests; a degree taught in English outside the UK may require an Ecctis assessment. For degree-level study, a higher education provider can assess English, but the level must still be equivalent to CEFR B2.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Where financial evidence is required, applicants need funds for course fees shown on the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS), plus living costs. GOV.UK describes exemptions for some applicants.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: For most courses, GOV.UK sets living costs at 1,171 pounds for each month of the course outside London and 1,529 pounds for each month in London, up to a maximum of 9 months. These amounts changed in the past, so check the page for the current figures.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Money can be shown through a student loan from a government, a government-sponsored loan company or a regulated student loans scheme, an official financial sponsorship, the applicant own money, a parent money with a letter confirming they agree to its use, or a partner money in some cases.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: When using personal or family money, the funds must have been held for 28 days in a row, counted back from the closing balance date on the most recent evidence. The evidence must be from no more than 31 days before the visa application date.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Accepted evidence includes paper or electronic bank statements, building society passbooks, certificates of deposit and letters from the bank. The evidence must show the account holder name, the bank name and the amount held. Funds in another currency are converted to pounds at the OANDA spot rate on the application date.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: These cannot be used as proof of funds: overdrafts, cryptocurrency, stocks and shares, pensions, accounts at banks not regulated in their own country, and accounts that do not use electronic record keeping.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Enough to pay the course fees shown on the CAS plus living costs. GOV.UK sets living costs at 1,171 pounds a month outside London and 1,529 pounds a month in London, up to 9 months. Check the page for the current figures.
retained_line_reviews.question: How much money must Indian students show for a UK Student visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: For personal, parent or partner bank funds, GOV.UK normally requires the balance to have been held for 28 consecutive days, counted back from the closing balance on the latest evidence. That evidence must be no more than 31 days before application. Loan and official-sponsorship evidence follows separate instructions.
retained_line_reviews.question: How long must the money be in the account for a UK Student visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Yes, if the parent controls the account and provides a letter confirming they agree to the money being used for the student.
retained_line_reviews.question: Can a parent money be used for a UK Student visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: GOV.UK: Financial evidence for Student and Child Student visa applicants
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Indian citizenship does not provide the listed nationality-based exemption. Other exemptions can apply, including an application for permission to stay after at least 12 months in the UK with a valid visa. Check the applicable circumstances.
retained_line_reviews.question: Can Indian students skip showing financial evidence for a UK Student visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Czech Ministry of the Interior: long-term study visa
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: A Czech long-term study visa is intended for third-country nationals undertaking eligible studies. Applications are normally made in person at a diplomatic mission. The visa can be valid for a maximum of one year. Check the study definition, documents and appointment procedure before submitting an application.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Czech Republic in New Delhi: Long-term visa and residence permit application
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Indian applicants for a long-term visa or long-term residence permit for study submit the application in person at the Czech Embassy in New Delhi, and an appointment must be booked beforehand.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Czech Republic in New Delhi: Booking appointments for study applications (India)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Appointments for Indian study applicants are given through registration windows announced by the embassy. A missed or late appointment is cancelled, so a new one must be arranged. Check the embassy page for the current dates.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Czech Republic in New Delhi: Long-term visa and residence permit application
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The embassy lists a 60-day decision period for study visa and study residence applications. Suspension of administrative proceedings can prolong the actual elapsed time.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Ministry of the Interior (ipc.gov.cz): Long-term visa for the purpose of studies
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: A long-term visa, including extensions, can be valid for a maximum of 1 year in total. A longer stay needs a long-term residence permit, which can also be applied for directly at the embassy.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Czech Embassy New Delhi: current long-term visa and residence guidance
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The embassy lists the travel document, photograph, proof of accommodation, evidence of the purpose of stay, financial evidence and criminal-record documentation, with conditions and exceptions. Use its current list rather than an older checklist.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Czech Embassy New Delhi: current document language and verification requirements
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Documents submitted with the application must be in Czech; bank statements may be accepted without translation. Indian public documents require an apostille, and originals or official copies are required as specified.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Czech Ministry of the Interior: study visa insurance
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Before receiving the visa, applicants normally provide medical insurance evidence. The Ministry of the Interior explains different insurance arrangements and exceptions, including rules for applicants under 18.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Czech Republic in New Delhi: Long-term visa and residence permit application
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: In person at the Czech Embassy in New Delhi, after booking an appointment through the embassy process.
retained_line_reviews.question: Where do Indian students apply for a Czech study visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Czech Republic in New Delhi: Long-term visa and residence permit application
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The embassy lists a 60-day period for study visa and study residence decisions; a suspension of proceedings can prolong the elapsed time.
retained_line_reviews.question: How long does a Czech study visa take?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of the Czech Republic in New Delhi: Long-term visa and residence permit application
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Yes. Documents submitted with the application must be in Czech, although bank statements may be accepted without a translation.
retained_line_reviews.question: Do documents need to be translated into Czech?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Migration Department of Lithuania: Services for persons abroad, Republic of India
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: For Indian applicants, the Migration Department lists VFS Global centres in New Delhi and Mumbai for temporary residence permits. retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Health insurance is mandatory for international students, and non-EU students must obtain private insurance or register with the Lithuanian health system.

retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Applications go through the Lithuanian migration system MIGRIS, and the Migration Department lists VFS Global centres in New Delhi and Mumbai as the service points for Indian applicants.

retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Indian students admitted to an accredited Latvian institution apply for a long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days. retained_line_reviews.source_label: European Commission: Latvia tuition and living costs
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The European Commission Latvia profile estimates student living expenses at 450 to 700 euros per month, including accommodation, food, local transport and study materials. retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of Latvia in India: Long stay visa for students, Indian nationals
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Indian nationals enrolled at accredited Latvian institutions apply for the long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days, and on entering Latvia the student applies for a residence permit at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of Latvia in India: Long stay visa for students
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Applicants from India must have their visa support document verified by the service provider Hello Verify India Private Limited before submitting the visa application. retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of Latvia in India: Long stay visa for students

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of Latvia in India: Long stay visa for students, Indian nationals
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The application form is completed online at epak.pmlp.gov.lv as a national visa (type D). VFS Global India applies service charges and a fee for the video conference, and documents count as submitted when the embassy receives them from VFS.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of Latvia in India: Long stay visa for students, Indian nationals
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: A proof of intended residence in Latvia must be submitted with the visa application.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of Latvia in India: Long stay visa for students, Indian nationals
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: A medical insurance policy is required. It can be obtained in the country of residence, in another country, or taken out by the inviting person.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Study in Europe (European Commission): Latvia country profile
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Non-EU students need health insurance that covers emergency medical care, inpatient treatment, emergency transportation to a medical facility, and repatriation in case of serious illness.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of Latvia in India: Long stay visa for students
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: At the Embassy of Latvia in India, through a VFS Global Latvia visa application centre, followed by a video or in-person interview with the embassy.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: In the UAE, the student residence visa is typically sponsored by the university or by a parent or relative who is a legal resident. It is valid for up to 12 months and renewed each year. The visa process usually starts with the sponsoring institution after admission, through the ICP portal or the GDRFA of the emirate.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: In the UAE, most universities teach in English. The consulate says a minimum IELTS Academic band of 5.5 to 7.0, or an equivalent TOEFL score, is typically required depending on the programme and institution. Confirm the requirement with the institution.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate advises students going to the UAE to plan for tuition fees, accommodation, health insurance, daily living costs, books and equipment, visa fees and an emergency fund, and to check tuition fees and refund policies on the institution website before committing.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate advises paying fees directly to the university official bank account rather than through third parties, and obtaining official receipts for every payment.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Doha: Advisory for students arriving for university education in Qatar
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: In Qatar, the Embassy of India in Doha notes that the cost of living is higher than in India and that accommodation is more expensive, and advises students to read about general living conditions before they go.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate states that scholarships for Indian students going to the UAE include institutional scholarships, Government of India scholarships and bilateral programmes, and encourages students to explore them before relying on self-funding.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: In the UAE, the student residence visa is typically sponsored by the university or institution, or by a parent or relative who is a legal resident. It is valid for up to 12 months and must be renewed each year of the programme.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The visa application is typically started by the sponsoring institution after admission, through the federal ICP portal or through the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) of the relevant emirate.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: On arrival, applicants above 18 must pass a mandatory medical fitness test at a government-approved centre, which includes a chest X-ray and blood tests. The visa is issued only after passing, and students then apply for an Emirates ID with biometric registration.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Doha: Advisory for students arriving for university education in Qatar
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: In Qatar, international students who do not hold a valid Qatar residence permit, excluding GCC citizens, must apply for a student visa. Confirm the current application steps and document requirements with the institution.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: UAE universities typically have two main intakes, September and January or February, and some institutions also offer a summer intake. The academic year is generally two semesters of about 16 to 18 weeks, and some universities use trimesters.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate lists these documents for the UAE: a passport valid for at least 6 months beyond the programme start date with two blank pages, the student entry permit or visa, the official admission or offer letter, proof of tuition payment, accommodation confirmation, and proof of financial sufficiency such as bank statements or scholarship letters.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Health insurance is mandatory in the UAE. Students on a sponsored university visa need valid cover from arrival, and short-term travel insurance is not accepted for residency. A long-term policy from a UAE-approved insurer is required, and many universities arrange group cover.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Indian academic documents may need attestation in a set sequence for the UAE, and the consulate notes that the UAE separately requires its own foreign ministry attestation for most official purposes. Check the requirement with the institution and use only government-authorised providers.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Riyadh: Useful information for Indian students in Saudi Arabia
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: For Saudi Arabia, the Embassy of India in Riyadh lists a confirmed place for the study programme at a recognised educational institution or university, and other documents required by the Saudi mission in India. Confirm the full list with the Saudi mission.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: In the UAE, students aged 18 and above may work part-time only with prior written permission from the sponsoring university and a work permit from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation. Part-time work is generally up to about 15 hours a week or 60 hours a month, though this may vary. Working without a permit can lead to visa cancellation and deportation.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate says recent graduates of universities ranked in the global top 500, as recognised by the UAE Ministry of Education, can apply for a Job Seeker Visa of 60 to 120 days with a financial guarantee. Outstanding graduates may qualify for a 10-year Golden Visa, with a minimum GPA of 3.5 to 3.8 or equivalent and graduation within two years.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Riyadh: Useful information for Indian students in Saudi Arabia
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The Embassy of India in Riyadh states that the holder of a Saudi student visa is not permitted to work in Saudi Arabia.

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Typically the university or institution, or a parent or relative who is a legal resident of the UAE. The application is usually started by the institution after admission.
retained_line_reviews.question: Who sponsors the UAE student visa for Indian students?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate advises confirming that the institution is accredited by the relevant UAE authority (CAA, KHDA or ADEK), and that the chosen programme is separately accredited, to make sure the degree is recognised.
retained_line_reviews.question: How can Indian students check that a UAE university is recognised?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Only with written permission from the university and a work permit from the UAE labour ministry. Hours are generally limited to about 15 a week, and working without a permit can lead to visa cancellation.
retained_line_reviews.question: Can Indian students work part-time in the UAE?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Yes. Students on a sponsored university visa need valid health insurance from arrival, and a long-term policy from a UAE-approved insurer is required. Travel insurance is not accepted.
retained_line_reviews.question: Is health insurance required for students in the UAE?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Consulate General of India, Dubai: UAE student advisory (2026 document)
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The consulate advises applying directly to the institution wherever possible. If an agent is used, it should be authorised by the institution, and students should avoid anyone who promises guaranteed visas or jobs.
retained_line_reviews.question: Should students use an agent to apply to UAE universities?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Doha: Advisory for students arriving for university education in Qatar
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: Students who do not hold a valid Qatar residence permit, excluding GCC citizens, must apply for a student visa, according to the Embassy of India in Doha.
retained_line_reviews.question: Do Indian students need a student visa to study in Qatar?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Riyadh: Useful information for Indian students in Saudi Arabia
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: No. The Embassy of India in Riyadh states that the holder of a Saudi student visa is not permitted to work in Saudi Arabia.
retained_line_reviews.question: Can Indian students work in Saudi Arabia on a student visa?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Doha: Advisory for students arriving for university education in Qatar
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The Embassy of India in Doha advises students to register with it and to stay in touch with the embassy and Indian community organisations for advice or help.
retained_line_reviews.question: Should Indian students register with the Indian embassy in Qatar?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Riyadh: Useful information for Indian students in Saudi Arabia
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The Embassy of India in Riyadh advises students to register with it by filling in the registration form on its website.
retained_line_reviews.question: Should Indian students register with the Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Bahrain: Registration of Indian Nationals and Indian Students in Bahrain
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: A Bahrain embassy press release dated 31 May 2022 requested Indian-passport students to register on the Global Pravasi Rishta Portal. This dated registration notice is not current visa or scholarship guidance.
retained_line_reviews.question: Should Indian students register with the Indian embassy in Bahrain?

retained_line_reviews.source_label: Embassy of India, Muscat: Registration of Indian Students
retained_line_reviews.confirmed_text: The Embassy of India in Muscat requests Indian students residing in Muscat, Oman for education or training to register with the embassy. This registration information does not establish admission, visa or work requirements.
retained_line_reviews.question: Does the Indian embassy provide student registration in Oman?
